claim: The paper's Llama-3-8B-Instruct experiments report new state-of-the-art point estimates among the methods in its table on AlpacaEval 2 and Arena-Hard.
required_final_evidence: Independent benchmark reproduction or immutable model generations sufficient to rerun the exact judges.
routes: Audit the author table, rankings, and claimed arithmetic.
Retrieve author code, checkpoint, generations, and exact training configuration.
Assess whether the official benchmark pipelines can be run from available artifacts under the no-GPU rule.
Attempt falsification using reported uncertainty and missing paired outcomes.
status_rule: BLOCKED when the report audit passes but no model/generation artifact permits independent evaluation and the reported uncertainty cannot decisively confirm or refute the leading comparison.
